## Implementation Overview
Clear description of what needs to be built, changed, or deployed as part of the rebranding initiative.

## Strategic Context
- **Rebranding Impact**: How this implementation supports the AI platform transformation
- **User Experience**: How this affects individual developers and enterprise users
- **Technical Foundation**: How this prepares for future AI features

## Technical Requirements

### Systems Affected
- [ ] CLI tool and commands
- [ ] Web interface (current/planned)
- [ ] Documentation and guides
- [ ] Repository structure
- [ ] CI/CD pipelines
- [ ] External integrations

### Functional Requirements
- **Core Functionality**: What must be built/changed
- **User Interface**: How users will interact with changes
- **Data Migration**: What data needs to be migrated
- **Integration Points**: How this connects with other systems

### Non-Functional Requirements
- **Performance**: Response time and throughput requirements
- **Reliability**: Uptime and error rate targets
- **Security**: Authentication, authorization, data protection
- **Scalability**: Expected load and growth requirements

### Breaking Changes
- **User Impact**: Yes/No - describe impact if yes
- **API Changes**: Backward compatibility considerations
- **Configuration**: Changes to user settings or files
- **Migration Path**: How users will transition

## Implementation Plan

### Phase 1: Planning and Preparation (Week X)
- [ ] Technical design and architecture review
- [ ] Dependency analysis and resolution
- [ ] Development environment setup
- [ ] Team coordination and role assignment

### Phase 2: Core Development (Weeks X-Y)
- [ ] Primary feature development
- [ ] Unit test creation
- [ ] Code review and iteration
- [ ] Documentation updates

### Phase 3: Integration and Testing (Week Z)
- [ ] Integration testing
- [ ] Performance validation
- [ ] Security review
- [ ] User acceptance testing

### Phase 4: Deployment and Monitoring (Week Z+1)
- [ ] Staging deployment and validation
- [ ] Production deployment
- [ ] Monitoring setup and alerting
- [ ] Post-deployment validation

## Technical Specifications

### Architecture
- **Components**: What will be built/modified
- **Dependencies**: Required libraries, services, or systems
- **Data Flow**: How data moves through the system
- **Security Model**: Authentication and authorization approach

### Development Standards
- **Code Quality**: Linting, formatting, review standards
- **Testing**: Coverage requirements and test types
- **Documentation**: Code comments and API docs
- **Performance**: Benchmarks and optimization targets

### Deployment Strategy
- **Environment**: Staging, production deployment approach
- **Rollout**: Blue-green, rolling, or big-bang deployment
- **Rollback**: How to revert if issues arise
- **Monitoring**: Health checks and alerting

## Risk Assessment

### High Risk Issues
- **Risk**: Potential blocking/critical issue
- **Impact**: What happens if this occurs
- **Probability**: Likelihood of occurrence
- **Mitigation**: Prevention and response plan

### Medium Risk Issues
- **Risk**: Issue requiring monitoring and planning
- **Impact**: Effect on timeline or quality
- **Probability**: Likelihood assessment
- **Mitigation**: Monitoring and contingency plan

### Dependencies and Blockers
- [ ] External system availability
- [ ] Third-party service integration
- [ ] Team resource availability
- [ ] Budget/procurement approval

## Success Metrics

### Technical Metrics
- **Performance**: Response time <Xms, throughput >Y req/s
- **Reliability**: Uptime >99.9%, error rate <0.1%
- **Quality**: Test coverage >90%, zero critical bugs
- **Security**: No vulnerabilities above medium severity

### User Experience Metrics
- **Adoption**: X% of users successfully migrate/adopt
- **Satisfaction**: User satisfaction score >8/10
- **Support**: Support ticket volume <X per week
- **Feedback**: Positive feedback ratio >80%

### Business Metrics
- **Timeline**: Implementation completed on schedule
- **Budget**: Costs within 10% of estimate
- **Quality**: Meets all acceptance criteria
- **Risk**: No critical issues post-launch

### Development Costs
- **Engineering Time**: XXX hours @ $XXX/hour

- **Testing**: User testing, performance testing tools

- **Start Date**: YYYY-MM-DD
